Root cause in its own log: repeated psycopg2.OperationalError retries (2-5, backing off 51s->234s) ending in 'FATAL: server login has been failing, cached error: connect timeout (server_login_retry)' against the DEA datacube. Cost 3.50 SU, wasted (0 composites produced).
